name: SANDJEST Nutritional Facts Nurse Tumbler, 20 oz
seoTitle: Nutritional Facts Nurse Tumbler, 20 oz Gift
metaDescription: A 20 oz nutritional facts nurse tumbler for nurses and nurse practitioners. A funny, budget friendly gift for graduation, Nurses Week, or a birthday.
summary: A 20 oz nutritional facts tumbler that jokes about what keeps nurses going, a light, budget friendly gift for nurses, NPs, and new grads.
whyItWorks: Clinic nurses and nurse practitioners often spend their day moving between exam rooms and a desk, and a 20 oz tumbler fits that rhythm. It is big enough for a real coffee and small enough to set beside a keyboard without taking over. The nutritional facts label adds humor that travels well across settings, from a busy hospital unit to a quiet family practice office.

Graduations are a great time for this one, especially for a new NP finishing a demanding program or a BSN grad heading into her first job. The joke lands with people who have survived nursing school, and the cup itself is something she will reach for every morning. It is budget friendly enough to give several to a graduating cohort or to tuck into a Nurses Week basket. Check the listing photos for the full label text.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the full label wording and lid style.

It is a good fit for NPs and clinic nurses, not just hospital nurses.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse practitioner?
faq.a: Yes, the title names practitioners, and the size suits clinic and office work. It makes a light gift for an NP graduation or work anniversary.

faq.q: Is it a good graduation gift?
faq.a: It works well for nursing school graduates, and it is easy to pair with a card, a lapel pin, or a badge reel.
